translation: Slightly cold, not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat cold and heat of the five viscera, chronic down-flowing diarrhea with pus and blood, stop wasting-thirst and great fright, dispel water, benefit the bones, harmonize the stomach, [benefit] the intestines, boost the gallbladder, and treat mouth sores. It grows at Wuyang and Shujun and Mount Tai.
